description:
Spacious Two Bedroom Apartment Available to Rent

Built to the highest standards, our apartments at Occu Adamstown feature modern frontages, welcoming interiors, and all the home comforts our residents require. 
Featuring private gardens, our apartments provide plenty of space for growing and established families alike. 

Standard features of Occu Adamstown apartments include:
- Open plan living area
- Balcony or terrace
- Dedicated storage
- Dedicated parking space
- Access to our resident's ClubHaus

Live in a growing community and enjoy easy access to recreation, education, local amenities and excellent transport links to Dublin City Centre.

At Occu, we believe that renting should be better. Thats why we're working hard to bring you the best: smarter, benefit focused and centred around the needs of our residents. 
No uncertainty, no hidden costs, stunning homes, and we'll let your pets move in too!

Please note, photos may not be specific to each available apartment but all apartments are finished to similar standard.

Occu. Better renting. That's different.
